snippet.title: Why Do Most Guys Never Get Abs?
snippet.description:
Most guys are not lazy. They are training without a clear goal or a plan built for them.
I show how AI connects a visual goal with a workout and nutrition plan that adapts when life changes.

Explore Abs By AI: https://absbyai.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video_ad_description&utm_campaign=dgen-trial-ra13

In this video, I explain how a goal image can guide a personal workout and nutrition plan, and how AI adjusts that plan around injuries, missed gym sessions and everyday life.

Chapters
0:00 Working without a clear plan
0:14 See your goal
0:28 Build a personal plan
0:39 Adjust when life changes

Some images and exercise demonstrations shown in the app are AI-generated. Goal images illustrate a possible result, not a guarantee.
